title: Privacy
analyticsHelp: Which screens and features are used, so we know what to improve. Not linked to your name and never used for advertising.
crashHelp: When the app fails, a technical report of what went wrong (device model, app version, the failing code).
never: We never sell data or track you across other apps. Chat, names and club details are never included.

update.title: Update required
update.body: This version of the app no longer works with the game server. Install the latest version to keep playing; your progress and account are kept.
